blocks.text: READ: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—University of the Philippines waited a full year—and one game—to finally see the impact Veejay Pre and James Payosing could make. Pre and Payosing delivered breakout performances as the Fighting Maroons routed Ateneo, 94-75, in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament Saturday night at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Pre needed a residency year and a quiet season opener against University of Santo Tomas before finding his footing again in the UAAP.
